intro.title: Expanding the Sea Within
description: It's okay not to force the waves of anxiety to settle.
We can't control the height of the waves, but we can deepen the sea within your heart.
Let's expand your sea now, creating space to hold even the roughest waves.
Through deep, calm breaths, meet the version of yourself that is far vaster and deeper than any wave.
intro.contentDescription: A practice of breathing with the rhythm of the waves, deepening your capacity to hold anxiety.
steps: 1. As the wave rises, breathe in deeply and expand the sea within.
2. As the wave falls, breathe out slowly and let the anxiety simply be.
3. Beneath the rolling waves, feel the deep, unshaken sea that is 'you.'
intro.tip: Tip: Rather than pushing the waves away, imagine deepening your sea so it can hold them with ease.

breath.restart:
Shall we take another breath 
to settle our hearts?

result.title: The sea within has grown deeper
description: Waves of anxiety sometimes come crashing in with great force.
We often try to stop or shrink those waves, but the size of the waves isn't ours to decide.
Yet within you lies a deep sea that can hold these waves.
Instead of forcing the waves away, you used your breath to expand the sea where they rest—making it larger and deeper.
The waves may remain the same size, but your sea is now deep enough to hold any anxiety with ease.
result.breathTime: You spent {{seconds}} seconds expanding the sea within.
